answers.note: Replaced the `as` cast with a typed declaration, `const slugifyWithLimit: (title: string, maxLength?: number) => string = slugify;`, and updated the comment. tsc now checks the real signature: an options-object second parameter fails with TS2322 (verified locally), while the base one-argument slugify still compiles, so the wp-5 tests still fail at run time rather than at compile time before the implementation.

Hoisted one `const titles = [...]` to the top of the file; the shape test iterates it directly and the wp-5 property test uses `[...titles, '!!!', '']`, adding only the two titles that slug to the empty string, which the shape regex cannot accept. A title added to `titles` is now covered by both tests.
